subject: Re: Quantrex MAP — schedule change, triage & rebaseline request
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@quantrex.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: David Lopez <d.lopez@quantrex.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quantrex MAP: internal resource delay — need to re-sync

Hi Rishi,

Quick heads-up from our PM team: the internal evaluation window we planned for next week has a resource conflict — the evaluation engineers were moved to a priority production incident and we need to push the in-depth eval by 7-10 business days.

This will affect the originally agreed go/no-go on 5/6 and likely slide our close by the end of May unless we can compress other workstreams. Can we schedule a short triage call to review:
- which MAP milestones can be deprioritized or run in parallel
- whether a reduced scope eval (subset of prompts + staged canary) would be acceptable to your procurement/legal team
- impact on procurement/contract signoff timeline

I attached the latest MAP (v3) and SOC2 attestation reference for your legal team.

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
Director of Product Operations
Quantrex

Attachment: Quantrex_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: SOC2-attestation-Quantrex.pdf (pdf)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantrex MAP: internal resource delay — need to re-sync

Claire — thanks for the flag and the attachments.

We can definitely triage and propose a pragmatic rebaseline that keeps you in the May go-live window if procurement flexibility exists. Suggested immediate next steps:
1) 30-min triage call tomorrow (4/21) to map critical path and decide reduced-scope eval or phased canary.
2) Redwood to propose a revised MAP with explicit tradeoffs (what we cut, what we run in canary, impact on SLA/unit pricing).
3) If procurement needs more lead time, we can propose a bridging commitment: signed letter of intent + limited committed capacity (net-zero-cost credit option) to hold pricing through May.

Laura & Neha — looping you both for availability and to capture any commercial flexibility.

Claire — are mornings PT OK for the triage? I can do 8:30–11:30 PT.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Quantrex — internal triage prep (commercial options + MAP edits)

Team — following Rishi's ask, I ran a quick comb through the MAP and commercial levers. Notes for the triage call:
- Commercial: we can offer a short-term holding credit (30 days) to lock price and capacity while the eval slips; larger discounts require leader approval (Marissa).
- Technical: suggest a 2-stage eval:
  * Stage A (canary): subset of 10 representative prompts, 1k tokens/session, run against a reserved pool for 1 week to validate quality and perf metrics.
  * Stage B (full eval): remaining prompt set + integration smoke tests — scheduled once Quantrex frees engineering bandwidth.
- MAP edits: move "integration smoke test" milestone from before POC sign-off to after canary, mark dependency as "conditional".

Action items for the call:
- Rishi: confirm if procurement will accept LOI or needs PO/contract before 5/6.
- Neha: prepare draft LOI template and credit language.
- Priyom: quick note on SLA exception mechanics for a staged rollout.

I'll join the triage and own the commercial sketch.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-commercial-options.md (note)

From: Claire Nguyen <claire@quantrex.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: David Lopez <d.lopez@quantrex.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 07:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantrex MAP: schedule change — triage call notes

Thanks Rishi & Laura — call was helpful. Quantrex can accept a staged approach provided the following are explicit in the revised MAP:
- Acceptance criteria for Stage A (quality thresholds, latency 95th pct target, and a small representative prompt set)
- Commitment to a firm hold on pricing through 5/31 if we sign LOI by 4/28
- Docs for procurement: SOC2 reference, simple statement of work + payment milestone options

Procurement needs the LOI language by 4/27 to route internally. If that timeline slips, our legal will require a full contract review which pushes the close past May.

David — can your team confirm the 10-prompt subset by EOD 4/23?

Claire

Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: approval request for short-term hold credit to protect May close

Team — quick escalation to secure the opportunity and prevent a May slip. Summary:
- Situation: Quantrex's evaluation window slipped due to their internal incident; they will accept a staged canary but require LOI by 4/27 to hold pricing through 5/31.
- Ask: approval to offer a 30-day hold credit (one-time, applied to first invoice) and LOI language that includes:
  * price hold until 2027-05-31 if LOI signed by 2027-04-27
  * commitment to run Stage A canary (10 prompts) within 7 business days of LOI signature
  * standard termination for convenience with 14-day notice if Stage A fails QA
- Commercial impact: negligible MRR loss if deal closes in May; if it slips beyond June, discount calculus changes.

Recommendation: approve hold credit and LOI template as a low-risk, high-probability lever to keep the close in May. If approved, Neha will finalize LOI and I will send to Claire 4/25 evening.

Please reply ALL with a one-line approve/decline by EOD 4/25.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
